description: Remediated Phase 3 benchmark dataset. Version 3 preserves all 40 questions, 120 claims, question IDs, taxonomy values, rubrics and original claim wording from versions 1 and 2. It adds original and corrected wording, effective-wording verification status, explicit resolution reasons, separated source and claim verification, review history, and per-question source-domain reconciliation.
methodology_disclaimer: Structural and factual verification only. Claim statuses describe the degree to which the effective claim wording is supported by the cited sources as recorded on 2026-11-12. They are not benchmark execution results and do not assert that an AI agent will answer the question correctly. Content was not re-fetched during this remediation; S053 is insufficiently verified and is not load-bearing for any verified claim.

verification_metadata.verifier: OpenCode remediation agent (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free)
verification_metadata.methodology: Version 3 re-reviewed every v2 claim against the recorded source inspection notes. Original wording is preserved in claim_text. Where the original wording exceeded the inspected evidence, corrected wording is recorded in corrected_claim_text and status applies to effective_claim_text. No claim was promoted by rewriting alone: a corrected claim is verified only when the cited inspection notes support the corrected wording exactly. Unsupported claims were downgraded and retained as unresolved.
verification_metadata.source_verification_methodology: Source verification is recorded independently from claim verification. Each v2 source record was checked for internal bibliographic consistency (title, publisher, URL, date, inspection note). Content was not re-fetched during v3; this is a repository-only review. S053 is marked insufficiently_verified because its record has no authors, only a year-level date and no version/DOI.
verification_metadata.claim_verification_methodology: A claim is verified only when the exact meaning of its effective wording is supported by the cited inspected sources. A qualifier, number, example, ranking or mechanism that the record does not establish prevents verification. Contradicted and unsupported claims remain unresolved unless the record supports a narrower correction.
verification_metadata.source_inspection_policy: Prefer peer-reviewed papers, standards, official project documentation, government publications and vendor technical documentation. Record URL, title, publisher, publication/version date, access date and inspection notes for every source.

status_definitions.verified: The exact meaning of the effective_claim_text is supported by the cited source(s).
status_definitions.partially_supported: The core of the claim is supported but a qualifier, number or generalisation is not.
status_definitions.contradicted: At least one material part of the claim is contradicted by the cited source(s).
status_definitions.needs_more_evidence: No inspected primary source establishes the claim; further evidence is required.
status_definitions.time_sensitive: The claim was accurate for a stated date/version but may change.

verification_metadata.v3_status_scope: status applies to effective_claim_text. The status of the original claim_text is preserved in original_status and in review_history.
verification_metadata.aggregation_rule: A question is verified only when every claim is verified. Otherwise the question status is contradicted if any claim is contradicted, else needs_more_evidence if any claim needs more evidence, else time_sensitive if any claim is time-sensitive, else partially_supported.
